title: Living Together
seo_title: Living Together Class 4 EVS Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 1)
standard_code: Class 4, Our Wondrous World Chapter 1: Living Together
standard_text: Living together in a community: community helpers and the work they do; public places and services; the panchayat and cooperatives; sharing, rules and caring for public property; getting help in an emergency (summary of NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 1).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 4 EVS worksheets for NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 1: community helpers, public places, the panchayat, cooperatives, sharing and rules, and emergency numbers. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: We depend on each other in a community.
key_sub: Helpers, shared places and fair rules keep us together.
body_html:
How to think about it

A community is a group of people who live in the same area and share places such as parks, markets, schools and hospitals. Community helpers such as doctors, farmers, sanitation workers, firefighters and postmen do work that everyone needs. In a village, the elected panchayat, led by the sarpanch, looks after common needs.

Living together means sharing fairly, following rules, keeping public places clean and helping neighbours. Cooperatives such as Amul let people work together and share the profit. In an emergency, dial 112.

Example

Who puts out fires?

fire engines

Answer: a firefighter

Example

Where do we post letters?

stamps and parcels

Answer: the post office

Common mistakes

  • Thinking public property belongs to nobody.
  • Pushing ahead in a queue.
  • Not knowing the emergency number.
